network: All pytest tests ran with existing autouse socket and DNS guards; fake model graph nodes, backend, and peer only.

findings_fixed.title: A2A timeout or cancellation releases the local conversion lock while the remote write may still commit
findings_fixed.evidence: Deterministic delayed fake peer reproduces duplicate dispatch on timeout, cancellation, and an unverified completed response. The new uncertainty marker blocks another send until a safe outcome is known.

findings_fixed.title: A2A client cleanup failure replaces a completed reply or the original failure
findings_fixed.evidence: Fake client.close raises after both successful and failed send. Cleanup is now logged without replacing either outcome; pre-dispatch factory failures are classified as not sent.

findings_fixed.title: Rule reload failure escapes the conversion recheck instead of returning a no-write response
findings_fixed.evidence: Injected OKFError during the last pre-dispatch policy read now returns a clear rejection and sends nothing.

extra_checks: Workflow fixture resets both conversion lock and uncertainty state per test.
Delayed remote completion is recognized on reread; existing order still blocks duplicate conversion.
Known pre-dispatch failures allow safe retry; verified completion clears uncertainty.
limits: Protection remains process-local and does not survive a restart or coordinate multiple replicas/other clients.
Restart is not a safe way to clear an uncertain result; an administrator must reconcile the remote work and order state first.
No persistent backend idempotency key was added; first Agent and MCP repeated conversion contract is unchanged.
No real Qwen/Gemini/API execution or main database writes were performed.
